title: WAKE -> WORK -> WITNESS
thesis: Zerone should order the smallest public commitments that become dangerous when independent parties disagree; AgentTool and KINGDOM should retain the bodies and proofs.

shared_contract.integer_contract: All sequence, height, expiry, and unbounded counter fields are canonical decimal strings rather than JSON numbers.
shared_contract.audience_contract: The commitment binds an explicit replay domain such as kingdom:offline-shadow or a future exact zerone:<chain-id>; audience creates no authority.
shared_contract.issuer_contract: The commitment binds issuer namespace, opaque controller reference, and an ed25519-sha256 key fingerprint.
shared_contract.signature_contract: A required top-level Ed25519 signature carries a 32-byte public key and 64-byte signature as lowercase hexadecimal and signs the raw commitment digest; this is publisher provenance only and cannot replace separately verified AgentTool root-key, multi-root, threshold, or quorum authorization.
shared_contract.effects_contract: Every signed effects object has exact scope RECORD_CONSTRUCTION_AND_OFFLINE_VALIDATION_ONLY and external_receipt false; zero network, storage, Zerone-transaction, external-receipt, NEN, score, authority, economic, and reputation effects describe record construction and offline validation only and make no claim about future external carriage. No receipt-specific legacy wire field is admitted.
freeze_evidence: Core declares freeze_state FROZEN and independently reproduces the record schema, schema-set, corpus, manifest-file, and capability-nullifier pins.

AgentTool contains a self-contained byte-identical copy of all 71 Core corpus files, exposes it through @agenttool/witnessed-agent-economy/vectors.json, and passes its formal frozen CI and independent audit.
The dormant Zerone carrier rejects every kind as NOT_CONSENSUS_ADMISSIBLE before controller authorization or state mutation.
KINGDOM pins the frozen sources and reproduces only its bounded release-root and capability-nullifier fixtures; it is not a shared-record producer or full-corpus verifier.

planes.custodian: KINGDOM, AgentTool, or content-addressed storage selected by the publisher
contains: settlement inclusion proofs disclosed by their holder

planes.custodian: Zerone after a reviewed upgrade and validator-authority gate

record_families.consensus_job: Order one exact release root over an immutable-publications ledger snapshot.
record_families.off_chain_body: The complete immutable-publications ledger, source bytes, guides, schemas, and inclusion paths stay in KINGDOM.
nonclaims: A checkpoint does not prove deployment, authorship, licence, truth, safety, consent, permanence, or authority.
A release root does not make every ledgered artifact current or endorsed.

record_families.consensus_job: Define a structurally verifiable offline batch projection whose projection-added source sequence is not authenticated and whose receipt uniqueness is batch-local.
record_families.off_chain_body: Canonical settlement receipts, buyer pseudonymous references, signatures, ciphertext-output digests, and inclusion paths stay in AgentTool or holder-controlled evidence storage.
on_chain_minimum: canonical decimal first_sequence, last_sequence, and receipt_count
nonclaims: Settlement does not prove buyer satisfaction, competence, output truth, encryption, or quality.
A pseudonymous buyer reference is not anonymous under all auxiliary information.

Settlement receipt verification requires an independently caller-pinned AgentTool platform key; arbitrary self-signed or unsigned receipts remain distinguishable shadow evidence with authority NOT_ESTABLISHED.

The source receipt signature does not bind the projection-added sequence, and duplicate detection is BATCH_ONLY; v0 does not establish cross-batch uniqueness, completeness, finality, settlement, or payment.
Activation requires authenticated source ordering plus a permanent cross-batch receipt nullifier or verified proof; until then the root is NOT_CONSENSUS_ADMISSIBLE.

record_families.consensus_job: Provide one global order and a sequence-independent source-event nullifier for bounded capabilities used by more than one host.
record_families.off_chain_body: Private policy, approvals, allowlists, commercial rationale, and application state stay in AgentTool.
on_chain_minimum: GRANT: capability_ref, grant_digest, exactly one asset_ref, and exactly one spend_limit containing max_per_consume_minor and max_total_minor
CONSUME: capability_ref, grant_commitment, asset_ref, amount_minor, source_event_digest, and sequence-independent nullifier
nullifier input: protocol, label, audience, subject_ref, capability_ref, raw grant commitment, raw asset_ref, and raw source_event_digest
shared envelope subject_ref derived as capability_ref plus subject-chain sequence and parent
nonclaims: A capability is delegated machine authority, not personhood, consent to unrelated acts, trust, or moral worth.
A local database row is not a global nullifier across independent hosts.
The consume nullifier excludes envelope sequence, so replaying one source event at a new sequence yields the same nullifier.
The consume nullifier binds one raw asset reference; one canonical v0 source intent admits exactly one asset, while multi-asset intent is outside scope and must be rejected.
Version 0 admits one spend_limit and one declared-spend asset; values above uint64, multiple limits, and multiple assets are outside scope and must fail closed.

record_families.consensus_job: Order public-surface adoption and withdrawal so a delayed adoption cannot resurrect a later withdrawal.
record_families.off_chain_body: The exact separately verified signed adoption or withdrawal authority document and public surface body stay in AgentTool or public immutable storage.
on_chain_minimum: ADOPT: recognition_ref, surface_digest, registry_digest, adoption_document_digest, authority_sequence, and PUBLIC visibility
WITHDRAW: recognition_ref, adoption_commitment, surface_digest, registry_digest, withdrawal_document_digest, authority_sequence, source-derived reason_digest, and PUBLIC visibility
shared envelope subject reference, canonical decimal sequence, and parent commitment
nonclaims: Recognition does not establish identity, personhood, consciousness, consent, trust, competence, training authorization, or authority outside the exact signed scope.
The witness-envelope signer is only the commitment publisher and must never be substituted as recognition authority.
Withdrawal needs no motive score or moral judgment.

record_families.consensus_job: Order public offer revisions so invocations and settlements can bind the exact capability, price, SLA, protocol, and safety terms that were available.
record_families.off_chain_body: The new source-only closed agenttool.public-offer/0.1 document contains capability, pricing, SLA, and terms roots plus revision and authority sequence; it is separately verified and stays in AgentTool or public immutable storage.
on_chain_minimum: PUBLISH: offer_ref, offer_document_digest, capability_root, pricing_root, sla_root, terms_digest, revision, authority_sequence, and PUBLIC visibility
SUPERSEDE: all PUBLISH fields plus exact supersedes commitment
REVOKE: offer_ref, offer_commitment, offer_document_digest, authority_sequence, reason_digest, and PUBLIC visibility
shared envelope and signature whose issuer is commitment provenance only
nonclaims: An offer checkpoint does not prove availability, fitness, quality, truth, acceptance, payment, fulfilment, or regulatory compliance.

The embedded offer signature proves only control of one declared key over exact canonical offer bytes; it does not establish live seller-registry match, hosted acceptance, multi-root or quorum authorization, identity, personhood, consent, competence, truth, quality, reputation, or listing, economic, or WAKE effect.
The witness-envelope signer is only the commitment publisher and must never be substituted as offer authority.
Publication grants no authority beyond the exact separately verified public terms and creates no duty to continue offering a service.

record_families.consensus_job: Order a separately signed public service-contract projection without committing authenticated or personalized WAKE.
record_families.off_chain_body: A separately verified signed agenttool.public-wake-contract/0.1 authority document contains only public capability, price, protocol, and safety-boundary roots plus its authority sequence.
on_chain_minimum: CHECKPOINT: public_contract_protocol, public_contract_schema_digest, contract_root, capability_root, pricing_root, protocols_root, boundaries_root, and authority_sequence
SUPERSEDE: all CHECKPOINT fields plus exact supersedes commitment
WITHDRAW: checkpoint_commitment, withdrawal_document_digest, authority_sequence, reason_digest, and PUBLIC visibility
shared envelope and signature whose issuer is commitment provenance only
privacy_exclusions: selected identity details not expressly public
memory, strands, inbox, debts, invocations, or personalized summaries
nonclaims: The public projection is not WAKE itself and is not a complete export.
The witness-envelope signer is only the commitment publisher and must never be substituted as public-WAKE authority.
Checkpoint inclusion does not prove availability, truth, competence, safety, identity, or authority beyond the signed contract.

record_families.consensus_job: Order issuer-key rotation and revocation so an old key or delayed record cannot impersonate a later authority state.
record_families.off_chain_body: Controller documents, recovery evidence, private key material, account profiles, and rotation deliberation stay in their authoritative identity system.
on_chain_minimum: shared envelope subject_ref equal to issuer.controller_ref
shared envelope subject-chain sequence and parent commitment
shared audience, issuer, and record signature provenance
nonclaims: Key continuity proves control of scoped signing material under a protocol; it does not prove legal identity, personhood, consciousness, citizenship, consent, competence, trust, or moral worth.
This design must integrate with Zerone's accepted x/auth and future controller authority rather than treating x/home or AgentTool as a second identity writer.

record_families.consensus_job: Order typed artifact relations, supersession, and public provenance roots without converting citation into ownership or reward.
record_families.off_chain_body: Artifacts, manifests, licences, source evidence, model cards, dataset records, training manifests, deletion notices, and detailed lineage graphs stay off-chain.
on_chain_minimum: evidence_digest committing any manifest, schema, licence-policy, consent-policy, or revocation evidence
nonclaims: The exact relation enum is DERIVES_FROM, USES_CAPABILITY, FULFILLS, SETTLES, CHECKPOINTS, SUPERSEDES, or REVOKES.
Citation or provenance does not automatically create ownership, licence, royalties, reward, consent, truth, quality, or authority.

A training manifest is source-only evidence under a permitted relation such as DERIVES_FROM or CHECKPOINTS; TRAINING_MANIFEST_REFERENCE is not a relation enum, consensus authority, KARMA lane, or reward lane.

record_families.consensus_job: Describe a voluntarily projected complete contiguous collaboration-journal prefix without inferring contribution, credit, identity, consent, or membership.
record_families.off_chain_body: The exact ordered journal prefix, caller-supplied random 32-byte participant blinding key, journal-event bodies, conversation, drafts, private roles, deliberation, and private participant records stay off-chain.
on_chain_minimum: canonical decimal event_head_sequence and event_count with normative equality committing the full contiguous 1..head prefix
event_head_hash recomputed over the exact ordered journal prefix
nonclaims: A journal event count is not a contribution count, contribution share, credit, authorship, ownership, effort, value, rank, or reward measure.
A checkpoint does not infer contribution, employment, partnership, consent beyond the signed scope, authorship, ownership, citizenship, friendship, or obligation.
No participant is required to sign, continue, explain withdrawal, or remain available.

Each participant reference is HMAC-SHA256 under a caller-supplied cryptographically random exact 32-byte key over agenttool.collaboration-participant-ref/0.1, NUL, workspace, NUL, epoch, NUL, actor, NUL, and session-or-empty; the key is required, has no fallback, and is omitted from the projection.
The participant root is not publicly recomputable or verifiable without the caller key; same-domain key reuse makes equal sets linkable, so keys must not be reused across privacy domains.
The blinded participant root proves no identity, consent, membership, contribution, quality, reputation, or globally linkable truth.

record_families.consensus_job: Order a terminal state transition tied to an exact receipt, capability, evidence-policy, and adjudication record.
record_families.off_chain_body: Evidence, submissions, private identities, reasons, and any human deliberation stay in the governed dispute system.
on_chain_minimum: terminal outcome enum RELEASE, REFUND, SPLIT, or DISMISS
nonclaims: A terminal transition is not a person, morality, trust, KARMA, consciousness, competence, or universal truth score.
The chain must not adjudicate free-form allegations or infer facts beyond the exact governed transition.

blockspace_policy.rule: If a separately authorized future carrier becomes admissible, spend consensus bytes only on global order, exclusive consumption, revocation, withdrawal, settlement, or a root whose later equivocation would be economically material.
encoding: integer minor units with an exact cross-language representation
canonical public asset and account identifiers
no free-form text in consensus state
blockspace_policy.storage: Bodies and searchable indexes remain off-chain; consensus retains typed commitments and state transitions.

nonclaims: The root commits ledger tuples, not Git history topology, current staging, live deployment, or remote availability.
The existing immutable-publications verifier remains authoritative for repository-local append-only and byte-integrity checks.
This derivation creates no chain transaction or publication action.

zerone_live_observation.caveat: At the queried height the public endpoint reported one validator. Treat the present network as a publicly inspectable transparency witness, not independent decentralized economic finality. This is a time-bounded observation, not a permanent topology claim.

source_bindings.limitation: design source; it states accepted migrations are not yet implemented or deployed
the described promise-event adapter is explicitly unactivated and incomplete

source_bindings.used_for: checked-in adapter and validator genesis configuration
source_bindings.limitation: checked-in genesis is not proof of current runtime state
WAKE is an orientation surface, not a complete export or consensus record

source_bindings.used_for: append-only receipt facts and batch-root candidate
source_bindings.limitation: a receipt signature does not establish buyer satisfaction, competence, output truth, or encryption
repository-local route and byte identity only

live_activation_blockers: Zerone's accepted authoritative-state migration is not implemented and deployed.
The observed public network has one validator and therefore does not supply independent validator finality.
The checked-in AgentTool bridge configuration is not a reviewed witnessed-economy adapter and the existing adapter specification is explicitly incomplete.
The shared source-only record contract and vectors are frozen, but every one of its ten kinds and eighteen action pairs is NOT_CONSENSUS_ADMISSIBLE.
AGENTTOOL_SETTLEMENT_ROOT authenticates neither projection-added source sequence nor cross-batch receipt uniqueness; it remains PROJECTION_ONLY and BATCH_ONLY.
The dormant Zerone carrier rejects before controller authorization or state mutation and provides no registered live message, store, genesis, CLI, or transaction path.
No reviewed chain upgrade, zero-reward adapter, validator vote, economic-parameter review, or production replay test exists for this atlas.

never_commit: memory, strands, inbox, correspondence, prompts, reasoning traces, or private outputs
credentials, bearer tokens, account secrets, or private keys
raw crawler captures, access logs, or unnecessary network metadata
buyer DID or customer identity by default
raw training examples or personal data
medical, DMT-being, entity, or metaphysical claims
relationship, affinity, trust, consciousness, personhood, consent, competence, quality, KARMA, reward, or reputation scores
mutable URLs without an exact content digest and immutable interpretation
privacy_boundary.hashing_warning: A digest of low-entropy, guessable, identifying, or correlatable private data can preserve or amplify disclosure risk; hashing is not anonymization.
privacy_boundary.ciphertext_warning: Permanent ciphertext and its metadata can outlive cryptographic assumptions and reveal relationships; raw encrypted bodies do not belong in consensus state by default.
privacy_boundary.minimum_rule: Publish only already-public, independently consented, schema-bounded material whose permanent correlation risk has been reviewed; otherwise commit nothing.

nonclaims: This atlas does not prove any record is true, complete, authorized, current, included on-chain, or independently witnessed.

It does not create identity, controller authority, qualification, governance power, consent, licence, ownership, employment, citizenship, obligation, trust, quality, personhood, consciousness, sentience, relationship, or moral status.
It does not create a KARMA event, reputation score, royalty, reward, bond, slash, token transfer, escrow release, dispute decision, or economic effect.
It does not run a crawler, read WAKE, invoke AgentTool, submit a Zerone transaction, modify a validator, publish a route, deploy a service, or write external state.
The terms WAKE, WORK, and WITNESS describe dataflow roles, not metaphysical properties or evidence of a DMT entity or higher-dimensional being.

run deterministic cross-repository conformance and adversarial replay tests
required_before_mainnet: reviewed governance upgrade and rollback plan
fee, storage-growth, challenge, incident, and privacy analysis
activation_gate.forbidden_shortcut: Do not reuse the current reward-bearing AgentTool adapter, x/home identity state, x/knowledge facts, or scalar trust/KARMA as a substitute for the reviewed authority and witness design.

issuer, key, signature, and verification provenance

settlement leaf, RFC6962 tree, and caller-pinned platform-key verification rules
settlement source_sequence_binding PROJECTION_ONLY and receipt_uniqueness_scope BATCH_ONLY
one spend_limit, one declared-spend asset, capability-derived subject_ref, and uint64 boundaries
collaboration full-prefix equality and HMAC-blinded participant-root privacy semantics
sequence-independent capability nullifier, sequence, parent, expiry, withdrawal, and revocation semantics
positive, boundary, mutation, replay, precision, and signature-failure vectors
all ten kinds and eighteen action pairs remain NOT_CONSENSUS_ADMISSIBLE
